content: Bwasumu Hi Aliga
Inoke Yehoba i baek Mosese elana i ba, “Nu na kin elana ge nu ba, ‘Yehoba ama Hibilu wama Yabowaine i ba ola hiwe: No gamagalau nu talamwagil nihi egon, inoke nihi na nihi tapwalolo elau.
Ebo nu kaisel ge iyoho ya nu kukukuhikagil,
inoke nau Yehoba no gasisi eliyana wam bwasumu hosi, donki, kamel, bulumwakau, sipi ge goti ona ali gila na teli nihi aliga.
Yaa Isileli wali bwasumu ali hehegan ni getoga Itipita wali bwasumu elal. Isileli wali bwasumu nige etega ni aaliga.
He nau Yehoba lan iyaka ya teli ya ba bwaligumwa hot te na ginol.’”
Lan i gan yaka Yehoba i ginol ola wana baaba. Itipita wali bwasumu gegewena hi loaliga, yaa Isileli wali bwasumu nige etega i aaliga.
Kin i loya ge i pwawa te Isileli wali bwasumu nige etega i aaliga. Yaa iyoho ya atena i gagasisi, yaka nige gamagalau i tatalamwagil hi eegon.
Baliyan
Yaka Yehoba i baek Mosese ge Eloni elal i ba, “Papakova ku gagalo ginaha ana abatontona, inoke Mosese ni aliheyan hawawala kin awonaa.
Yaka papakova ni ola kasukasu ge ni lovaleyan Itipita gamwana gegewena ni pwawa. Inoke gamagalau ge bwasumu nihi youbabaliyan ge nihi youbonbon.”
Inoke papakova hi gagalo ginaha ana abatontona ge hi na hi talmilil kin manininaa, yaka Mosese i aliheyan hawawala kin awonaa. Inoke gamagal ge bwasumu hi youbabaliyan ge hi youbonbon.
Tokukula nige bosowailiya nihi nem nihi talmilil Mosese matanaa kaiwena hi youbabaliyan, i ola al Itipita gegewel.
Yaa Yehoba kin atena i pagasisi inoke Mosese ge Eloni analiya nige i hahago, i ola valila Yehoba wana baaba.
Mwasiyal

Inoke Yehoba i baek Mosese elana i ba, “Bwaligumwa mweluluga kekeisi nu lut, yaka nu na kin nu kite ge nu baek elana nu ba, ‘Yehoba, ama Hibilu wama Yabowaine, i ba ola hiwe: No gamagal nu talamwagil nihi egon, inoke nihi na nihi tapwalolo elau.
Ebo nigeya, yaka logabola nanakil hot na ginol alomwau am tolabe ge wam gamagalau eliyamiu. Inoke nu atena nige etega al panayawiya i oola nau.
Bosowaina valila nimwau na paelu ge logabola etega na ginol alomwau wam gamagalau eliyamiu ge na gul habamiu panayawiya.
Yaa ya telewa u tabwa kin, kaiwena nuwau no gasisi na pankitewa, inoke wasau ni lelu panayawi gegewena ni soli.
Owa wam logugui i gasisi no gamagal elal ge u lopwalil nige hi eegon,
inoke bwaligumwa ni ola te sauga e kehe kalakalapatina
na palau, kehe ololana o nige sauga etega i lolowa Itipita.

He nu ba totuwalali elal wam bwasumu ge bugul gegewena bolo hi miminaa noleleya nihi bugul tukagil ligumwa. Kaiwena gamagal ge bwasumu bolo nige hi uulutuk ligumwa, nasi kehe kalakalapatina ni lolil ge nihi aliga.’”
Kin ana tolabe enuna hi lovakun Yehoba wana baaba kaiwena, inoke etimwawa wali totuwalali loloyowanil ge wali bwasumu hi palou tukagil.
Yaa bolo nige hi nuwanuwatu Yehoba wana baaba kaiwena inoke wali totuwalali loloyowanil ge wali bwasumu nige hi papalou tukagil.
Yaka Yehoba i baek Mosese elana i ba, “Nimwam u paeluek labulabumwa, inoke kehe kalakalapatina ni lau Itipita gamwana gegewena elana, ni lowa gamagal, bwasumu, ge bugul siusiunil eyowaa pwataliyaa.”

Inoke Mosese wana suki i paeluek labulabumwa yaka Yehoba gulumwawa ge kehe i patuna, inoke pinamal panuwa i lol. Kehe kalakalapatina Yehoba i palau ge Itipita ana labi gegewena pinamal i topainan. Kehe ololana o nige sauga etega i lolowa Itipita.
Itipita labi gegewena elal kehe kalakalapatina bugul gegewena bolo noleleya i apapanak-agil, i ola al gamagal ge bwasumu. Bugul bolo siusiunil eyowaa i paanlolowagil ge ebwakil lamwaliya i olan palo.
Yaa kehe nige i lolowa labi Gosen, Isileli wali abaminaa.
Yaka kin Mosese ge Eloni i yogaagil ge i ba, “Iyaka ya gegi. Yehoba wana ginol i sapu, nau alowau no gamagalau ha gegi.
Ku awanun Yehoba elana! Besema gulumwawa ge kehe! Ya talamwagimiu nuku egon, nige al nuku mimina.”

Yaka anana Mosese i lahe i ba, “Sauga na tagil panuwa ya elana, inoke nimwau na latahin ge na awanun Yehoba elana. Inoke gulumwawa ni bakuhu ge kehe ni mainum. Yaka nu atena panayawi iya Yehoba wana panayawi.
Yaa ya atena owa ge am tolabe nigeya ga Yehoba Yabowaine ku lolovakun-an.”
(He mwawin palakes toto kaliko hi ginoliya, ge aanan bali kehe i apapanak-agil, kaiwena bali iyaka i matuwa ge palakes lanina abwe i pwela.
Yaa witi nige i nanak, kaiwena nigeya ga ana sauga matuwa i oola.)
Yaka Mosese kin i eguluwan i notagil panuwa tolinaa, inoke nimana i latahin i awanun Yehoba elana, yaka gulumwawa i bakuhu ge kehe i mainum.
Sauga kin i kite kehe i mainum ge gulumwawa i bakuhu, yaka i gegi al, alonau ge ana tolabe ateliya hi pagasisi.
Inoke Isileli nige i tatalamwagil hi eegon, i ola valila Yehoba wana baaba Mosese elana.

footnotes.text: Bugul ya nige i mamasal kila wala labi elana, yaa tultul kaiwena kehe i kalapat i ola ais (ice).
